# Lettuce

> Lettuce is a comprehensive financial platform for solopreneurs that automates S Corp formation, tax filing, payroll, and accounting with AI-powered tools and healthcare benefits.

Lettuce serves independent professionals across multiple industries including content creators, real estate agents, therapists, consultants, and healthcare workers. The platform combines tax optimization, automated accounting, and group-rate healthcare benefits through Lettuce Pro, with a guarantee that the service pays for itself through tax savings.

## Key Topics

- S Corp formation and setup
- Tax savings and optimization
- Self-employment tax reduction
- Solopreneur financial management
- Automated payroll and accounting
- Healthcare benefits (Lettuce Pro)
- Retirement planning (Solo 401k)
- Business structure (LLC alternatives)
- Freelancer and creator accounting
- Tax deductions
- LettuceHead AI
- Lettuce-Back Guarantee
- FDIC-insured banking
- Visa debit card
- Self-employed accounting
